transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in because, for a long time now, I’ve just had this heavy, low feeling sitting on me most days. I mean, I'm still getting through my driving routes and my volunteer shifts alright, but... it just feels like I’m going through the motions instead of really being in my own life. Just sort of weighed down, I guess.
Has this low, heavy feeling been present most days for at least two years?
Yeah, it has. It's been going on for about three years now. It started right around the time my father died, and it just hasn't really lifted since then.
During these past three years, have you had a period of at least two weeks when the depression became much worse than your usual baseline?

No, I don't think so. It's just been pretty much the same... steady, low feeling the whole time. I haven't really noticed it getting a lot worse for a couple of weeks or anything like that. Just this constant weight, you know?
Do you feel this low mood is mostly centered on missing your father and his death?

No, not really. I mean, I miss him, sure, and it started when he passed, but... it doesn't feel like it's just about him anymore. It's not like I'm sitting around crying over his death every day. It's just this general, flat feeling that stuck around after he was gone, and it covers everything else in my life now.
Do you often feel anxious or worried, even when there isn’t a clear reason?

No, I wouldn't say I get anxious. I mean, if something comes up at work or with the bills, sure, I might worry a bit like anyone else would. But I don't just feel anxious out of nowhere for no reason. It's really just that flat, heavy feeling all the time, not feeling nervous or anything like that.
